fields.schemeName: Scheme to Provide Assistance for Setting Up Farmer Support Centers in State Market Committees and for Computerization of All Market Committees
fields.briefDescription: This scheme has been introduced by the Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Cooperation Department, Gujarat. It aims to establish farmer support centers at market committee levels and computerize all market committees in Gujarat.

fields.schemeName: Goa State Export Market Development Scheme, 2008
fields.briefDescription: The scheme "Goa State Export Market Development Scheme" encouraged Goan industries to improve export markets and support them in establishing their goods firmly in the export market. It provided interest-free loans up to ₹5,00,000/- for participating in exhibitions and market study tours abroad.

fields.schemeName: Creation of Modern Facilities in Market Committee: Scheme to provide assistance foe setting up modern facilities in Market Committee
fields.briefDescription: This scheme has been introduced by the Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Cooperation Dept., Gujarat. It aims to provide financial assistance to Market Committees for setting up modern facilities, improving agricultural infrastructure, and enhancing the competitiveness of agricultural markets.

fields.schemeName: Scheme to Provide Assistance to Sate Market Committees as well as Taluka-District Co-operative Purchase and Sale Union to Construct Large Size Warehouse Godowns
fields.briefDescription: This scheme has been introduced by the Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Cooperation Department, Gujarat. It aims to provide financial assistance to State Market Committees and Taluka-District Co-operative Purchase and Sale Unions for constructing large-sized warehouse godowns

fields.schemeName: Gujarat Textile Policy: Assistance to SHG for Job Work (Fiscal Incentives to Labour Intensive Unit)
fields.briefDescription: The "Gujarat Textile Policy" introduced by the Industries and Mines Department aims to create a vibrant Textile Sector ecosystem and generate enormous employment opportunities in the State.

fields.schemeName: Interest Subsidy Scheme for Scheduled Caste/Scheduled Tribe Entrepreneurs
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to encourage SC/ST entrepreneurs to establish micro or small-scale service enterprises & to expand, diversify, or modernize their existing units. Under this scheme, a loan amount ranging from a min. of ₹20.00 lakhs to a max. of ₹1,000.00 lakhs is provided at an interest rate of 4%.

fields.schemeName: To Increase Fish Seed Production and Inland Fisheries Equipment in Tribal Areas
fields.briefDescription: This scheme has been introduced by the Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Cooperation Department, Gujarat. It aims to enhance fish production and provide employment opportunities to Scheduled Tribes (ST) individuals engaged in inland fisheries.

fields.schemeName: Construction of Dudhghar/ Godown (Scheduled Tribe Area)
fields.briefDescription: The scheme "Construction of Dudhghar/ Godown (Scheduled Tribe Area)" provides financial assistance for the construction of Dudhghar (milk storage unit) and Godown (cattle feed storage) for Village Milk Producer Co-operative Societies in Scheduled Tribe areas of Gujarat.

fields.schemeName: West Bengal Incentive Scheme for Approved Industrial Park (SAIP) for MSMEs: Construction of Approach Road
fields.briefDescription: The “Construction of Approach Road” under the “SAIP for MSMEs” scheme, facilitates the Private Industrial Park in provision with Approach Road catering to the AIP.

fields.schemeName: Marathi Drama Competition ‘A' & ‘B' Group
fields.briefDescription: The scheme "Marathi Drama Competition 'A' & 'B' Group" is a state-level initiative by the Kala Academy, under the Department of Art and Culture, Government of Goa. It provides a platform to urban and rural theatre groups and offers transport assistance for artistes and stage material as per govt.

fields.schemeName: Scheme for Additional Interest Subsidy over and above RIPS 2024 and Reimbursement of Annual Credit Guarantee Fee
fields.briefDescription: As per the MSME Policy 2024, it supports the establishment of new MSMEs and the expansion, diversification, or modernization of existing ones by offering interest subsidies and reimbursement of guarantee fees to ease access to finance and reduce the cost of credit.

fields.schemeName: One Act Play competition at High School, Higher Secondary School and College level (Konkani, Marathi & English)
fields.briefDescription: The "One Act Play Competition" is a Cultural Scheme by the Department of Art, Culture and Museums, Government of Goa, encouraging students' personality development through theatre, with participation open to all Goan schools and colleges, and transport assistance provided as per government norms.

fields.schemeName: Scheme for Supply of Improved Seeds for Fodder
fields.briefDescription: The "Scheme for Supply of Improved Seeds for Fodder" aims to supply improved quality fodder seeds to registered Gaushalas and Panjarapols to ensure round-the-year green fodder availability for livestock.

fields.schemeName: Uttarakhand Tourism Entrepreneur Promotion Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to aims to encourage and financially strengthen permanent residents/entrepreneurs of the state who invest ₹1 crore to ₹5 crore in the tourism sector.

fields.schemeName: Mahila Nursery Yojana
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to promote nursery establishment by providing women's groups with high-quality seedlings or saplings from certified sources, along with a fixed grant, technical support, and training to ensure effective nursery operations.

fields.schemeName: Rural Sports and Health Promotion Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The scheme promotes fitness among rural youth by providing financial assistance to the mangal dals for setting up open gyms in each Gram Panchayat. Financial assistance of ₹17,960/- is allocated per gram panchayat for installing open gym/community fitness equipment to encourage fitness & well-being.

fields.schemeName: Scheme of Grants-in-Aid for supporting professional associations/ organisations of social scientists, companies and trusts duly registered under the Companies Act for their development
fields.briefDescription: The Indian Council of Social Science Research (ICSSR), under the Ministry of Education, Government of India, provides Grants-in-Aid for supporting professional associations/ organisations of social scientists, companies and trusts  for their development.

fields.schemeName: Assistance to Scheduled Castes for Fisheries: Prawn Seed Stocking Gujarat
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to increase fish production by rearing fish in reservoirs and to provide employment to Scheduled Caste (SC) individuals involved in inland fisheries activities.

fields.schemeName: Grants Provisioned under Uttarakhand Tourism Policy, 2023
fields.briefDescription: The aims to promote sustainable tourism development in the state by encouraging private and institutional investment in the tourism sector through targeted financial incentives and subsidies.

fields.schemeName: Entrepreneurship and Development Programme
fields.briefDescription: Under this scheme, interested entrepreneurs, NGOs, scientists, researchers, and teachers from across the state are provided support to convert natural resources into viable business opportunities by enhancing technology and value addition.

fields.schemeName: Pandit Deen Dayal Upadhyay Vigyaan Gram Sankul Pariyojana
fields.briefDescription: The project aims to promote sustainable rural development through the application of science & technology to enhance livelihoods in selected villages throughout Uttarakhand. Under the project, rural development initiatives are implemented through the formation of village clusters across the state.

fields.schemeName: Scheme to Provide Financial Assistance to Registered Organizations/Government Organization/Non-Government Organizations/Institutions for Running Residential Facilities/Half Way Homes for Persons with Disabilities
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to registered organizations, Government organizations, and institutions for running residential facilities or halfway homes for Persons with Disabilities. The scheme provides financial support in the form of operational grants.

fields.schemeName: Drone Policy 2023 - Information Technology Development Agency
fields.briefDescription: The policy aims to promote the use, innovation, and development of drone technology for improving service delivery and governance in Uttarakhand, while strengthening the drone ecosystem through collaboration among industry, academia, and government.

fields.schemeName: World Bank-funded Uttarakhand Drinking Water Programme (For Semi-Urban Areas)
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide affordable and reliable domestic drinking water connections to eligible households in selected semi-urban areas of Uttarakhand, ensuring improved access to safe and adequate drinking water.

fields.schemeName: Swachh Bharat Mission (Grameen - Waste Management) - Uttarakhand
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to promote sustainable solid and liquid waste management in rural Uttarakhand by providing necessary infrastructure and facilities to ensure cleaner villages, improved sanitation, and better public health.

fields.schemeName: Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchayee Yojana - Har Khet Ko Pani (Groundwater Irrigation Scheme) Uttarakhand
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide assured and sustainable irrigation to every farm by developing groundwater-based irrigation facilities for farmers. This scheme is a centrally sponsored scheme with a funding pattern of 90% Central share and 10% State share.

fields.schemeName: Jal Jeevan Mission (Har Ghar Jal Yojana) - Uttarakhand
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide every rural household in Uttarakhand with safe and adequate drinking water through household tap connections, ensuring the supply of 55 litres of potable water per person per day.

fields.schemeName: Establishment of Tea Factories - Uttarakhand Tea Development Board
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to promote the development of the tea industry in Uttarakhand by establishing tea factories for processing locally produced green leaves, generating local employment, enhancing farmers’ income through fair procurement, and developing a sustainable tea value chain in the state.

fields.schemeName: To Increase Fish Seed Production and Inland Fisheries Resources in Tribal Areas: Prawn Seed Stocking - Gujarat
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to increase fish production by rearing fish in reservoirs and provide employment to people involved in inland fisheries activities.

fields.schemeName: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY-Inland): Medium Biofloc Establishment - Gujarat
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to increase fish production by rearing fish in reservoirs and provide employment to people involved in inland fisheries activities.

fields.schemeName: Ayurswasthya Yojana: AYUSH and Public Health
fields.briefDescription: The scheme-component aims to promote AYUSH-based interventions to improve community health outcomes by supporting preventive, promotive, curative, and rehabilitative healthcare services.

fields.schemeName: A Scheme to Provide Assistance for Building E-Market Facilities in Market Committees
fields.briefDescription: This scheme provides financial assistance to market committees in Gujarat to establish e-market facilities, aligning with the National Agriculture Market Policy for a unified national e-market.

fields.schemeName: Assistance to Co-operative Irrigation Societies M. N. R.-10 (General Area)
fields.briefDescription: The scheme "Assistance to Co-operative Irrigation Societies, M. N. R.-10 (General Area)"  aims to increase agricultural production by supporting irrigation cooperative societies through the provision of pumps and electric motors for efficient water distribution.

fields.schemeName: Assistance to Trusts/Institutions for Setting Up Cultural Centers/Auditoriums in the Municipal Area
fields.briefDescription: The scheme "Assistance to Trusts/Institutions for Setting Up Cultural Centers/Auditoriums in the Municipal Area" aims to promote cultural infrastructure through financial assistance to trusts and institutions for building or renovating cultural centres within municipal areas.

fields.schemeName: Startup India Seed Fund Scheme- For Startups
fields.briefDescription: The scheme “Startup India Seed Fund Scheme (SISFS)” was launched by the DPIIT on 19th April 2021 with an outlay of INR 945 Crore to provide financial assistance to startups for Proof of Concept, prototype development, product trials, market-entry, and commercialization.

fields.nodalMinistryName: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology
fields.schemeName: Electronic Manufacturing Clusters (EMC) Scheme: Common Facility Centres/ Brownfield Electronics Manufacturing Clusters
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to support the upgradation of Brownfield EMCs through Common Facility Centres (CFCs). It provides financial assistance for infrastructure improvement and shared facilities for existing electronics manufacturing units.

fields.nodalMinistryName: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology
fields.schemeName: Scheme for Promotion of Manufacturing of Electronic Components and Semiconductors (SPECS)"
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to offset the disability for domestic manufacturing of components and semiconductors to strengthen the electronics manufacturing ecosystem. Through this scheme, a financial incentive of 25% on capital expenditure to legal entities registered in India.

fields.nodalMinistryName: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology
fields.schemeName: Production Linked Incentive Scheme (PLI) for IT Hardware Scheme 2.O
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to promote domestic manufacturing of Laptops, Tablets, All-in-One PCs, Servers, and Ultra Small Form Factor (USFF) devices in India through production-linked financial incentives.

fields.nodalMinistryName: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology
fields.schemeName: Electronics Component Manufacturing Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide financial incentives for manufacturing electronic components in Bharat. Through this scheme, turnover and capital expenditure-linked incentives are provided to companies and Limited Liability Partnerships.

fields.schemeName: The West Bengal Incentive Scheme: Capacity Utilisation
fields.briefDescription: “Capacity Utilisation” incentives under the “The West Bengal Incentive Scheme” implemented by the Dept. of Tourism, Government of West Bengal, aims to provide additional Floor Area Ratio (FAR) over and above the maximum permissible FAR as may be fixed by the competent authority.

fields.nodalMinistryName: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology
fields.schemeName: India BPO Promotion Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to create employment opportunities and promote investment in the IT/ITeS sector by establishing BPO/ITeS units in smaller cities. Through this scheme, financial support in the form of Viability Gap Funding is provided to eligible companies.

fields.schemeName: Technology Acquisition Assistance
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to support Micro and Small enterprises in state to acquire advanced technology/ software related to their production/ manufacturing processes through assistance towards cost incurred for technology/ software acquisition.

fields.schemeName: Sagar Samman Award- Sagar Samman Varuna Award
fields.briefDescription: This scheme aims to recognize outstanding maritime contributions by providing top national recognition to distinguished maritime professionals.

fields.schemeName: Ayush Oushadhi Gunvatta evam Uttpadan Samvardhan Yojana (AOGUSY): Pharmacovigilance of ASU&H Drugs Including Surveillance of Misleading Advertisements
fields.briefDescription: The scheme-component aims to establish a robust safety monitoring and surveillance system for Ayurveda, Siddha, Unani and Homoeopathy (ASU&H) drugs and to monitor misleading advertisements related to Ayush medicines.

fields.nodalMinistryName: Ministry Of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
fields.schemeName: Assistance to Training Institutions Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance for creation, strengthening, and expansion of training institutions under MSME for skill development and entrepreneurship training.

fields.schemeName: Development Support for Coffee in Traditional Areas: Support to Small Growers' Collectives/ SHGs/ Cooperatives for Coffee Marketing
fields.briefDescription: The objective of the scheme is to extend support to small and tiny growers, incentivizing them to form collectives/ Self Help Groups/ Cooperatives, thus encouraging them to take up marketing of coffee produced on a community-based approach through suitable financial incentives.

fields.schemeName: Shahari Waqf Sampatti Vikas Yojana
fields.briefDescription: Under the scheme, interest free loan to Waqf Boards (WBs)/waqf institutions is granted to various Waqf Boards and Waqf Institutions in the country for construction of economically viable buildings on the Waqf land, such as commercial complex, marriage halls, hospitals, cold storage etc..

fields.schemeName: Comprehensive Handicrafts Cluster Development Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance, infrastructure development, skill upgradation, and market linkage support to artisans, craftsmen, and cluster-based enterprises.

fields.nodalMinistryName: Ministry Of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
fields.schemeName: Consortia & Tender Marketing Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to facilitate Micro and Small Enterprises (MSEs) in marketing their products and services through individual or collective participation in tenders via consortia. It helps MSEs secure bulk orders, improve competitiveness, and access government procurement opportunities.

fields.schemeName: Technology Development And Utilization Programme For Women
fields.briefDescription: In order to meet the specific needs of women and to enhance the contribution of women towards technology capability building, the “Technology Development & Utilization Programme for Women (TDUPW)” has been formulated by the Department of Scientific and Industrial Research (DSIR).
